# Changelog

## Version 3.2

- Added Open .ir for turning an existing standard remote into an editable IR Builder project.
- Added automatic mapping for 16 Power, Volume, Channel, Mute, navigation, Menu, Back, and Input controls.
- Added a third Other buttons screen for unmatched imported signals.
- Increased the unmatched-button limit from 24 to 48 and retained duplicate signals with unique labels.
- Moved finished standard remotes to the infrared/ir_builder folder.
- Added format-4 project metadata while retaining project formats 1 through 3.

## Version 3.1

- Added a connected five-way navigation controller with dedicated Menu, Back, and Input icons.
- Added high-contrast focus and configured-key indicators.
- Added a bundled TV builder library with native OK, direction, Menu, Back, and Input candidate groups.
- Added automatic first-launch library installation and a configurable library setting.
- Added native navigation editing, scanning, saving, exporting, and repeat support.
- Improved scan speed, signal caching, cancellation, file browsing, and project recovery.
